scope: GO2+arm, fixed perception target, physics and two 1280x720 camera workers; no DDS or WebRTC viewer
cold_cache_policy: Separate empty Genesis, Quadrants, Numba and CUDA cache paths for every cold process; existing application caches and containers preserved
startup_scope: Assets through both first camera frames; excludes Python imports and container startup

cold_profile.scope: Separate fresh-cache cProfile around physical Scene.build only; camera workers omitted; same physical configuration

build_path_breakdown.function: Other direct rigid-substep kernel calls: dynamics, inequality and post-step integration

cold_profile.interpretation: Scene.build performs an initial physics step to compile simulation kernels; collision detection and constraint solving dominate that step
limitations: Profiler overhead is included; these values do not partition the unprofiled 150.07-second run
The kernel view overlaps the build-path breakdown; AST transformation is included in materialize
Native compilation and execution inside launch_kernel are not separately resolved by Python cProfile
Cameras build in parallel; their times must not be summed
The 1.4.1 baseline uses the same current application source and resolved settings, with its older installed Genesis stack; unused RL source is absent from the candidate runtime image
One preliminary short trial ended before first camera frames; it was retained as failed and is excluded from these completed runs
Quadrants cache-lock warnings occurred during cold camera shutdown; the subsequent warm run completed
No physical Robot, live multi-host DDS or connected WebRTC viewer was exercised
